- The synthetic fixture of the cutover extract, the view fixture and the rwb-case contract mock exist before the first build, so the story starts after its two in-lane predecessors and needs no production data (section 12.8).
- The cutover reconciliation harness pack is agreed at the wave 4 entry check (GAP-0443): a cutover extract fixture with case, account and party rows plus `source` and `migrated_at`, a reconciliation extract with one row per orphan and its reason, a report per business date, a retention that matches the wave evidence, and a gate that fails on any unresolved key or suppressed break. - The source of the legacy extract, its format and the place that holds the sign-off are given by no source document: the extract is read once from the legacy Workbench cutover dump, lands nothing, and the sign-off is held in the cutover record of the release pipeline (GAP-0522; ASM-0717).
- The owner-side load is the owning service's own Flyway step under `RWB-PLT-E1044-CON`, run in the same cutover step as this story's extract; no story ID is invented here, and the delta is recorded against the owning service's story set (GAP-0236).

edits.new: 7. rwb-case reads the handed-over extract and loads it into `rwb_case` through its own cutover migration on its own Flyway sequence, which sets the `source` and `migrated_at` of every migrated record. This story does not run that migration and holds no grant on `rwb_case` (DP-01; DP-15). The load runs under the owner's migrator login created by `RWB-PLT-N011-DB`, in the owner's schema; this story never writes another service's schema (GAP-0237).

edits.old: 11. After the sign-off the legacy Workbench tables stay read-only for their retention period and the migrated records are served from `rwb_case` through the rwb-case contract (legacy AC3).
edits.new: 11. After the sign-off the legacy Workbench tables stay read-only in place for the retention class of their content under the P5 retention_rule (DP-01), and the migrated records are served from `rwb_case` through the rwb-case contract (legacy AC3). The data steward signs each schema's cutover before the archive date is set (GAP-0241).
